item.title: [IGNITE-23623] Flaky testMissHitPercentage
item.description:
GridCacheAbstractMetricsSelfTest#testMissHitPercentage test is flaky if we run GridCacheAtomicPartitionedMetricsSelfTest. It looks like testNonTxEvictions is the reason of the problem because if we add small delay after testNonTxEvictions, everithing will be fine. The problem was that the GridCacheAbstractSelfTest#afterTest method failed after running testNonTxEvictions, so it did not finish clearing the cache. The reason was that afterTest used jcache, which returned IgniteCache<String, Integer>, but the tests used IgniteCache<Integer, Integer>. Log:
